script_text: Gemini, this week is no reset; it's a launch code for your income. Monday and Tuesday, the New Moon and Venus in your 1st House conjunct, then Venus sextiles Mars in your 12th, boosting romance and deals. Tuesday's risk: Mercury, your ruling planet, retrograde in your 3rd, squares Jupiter in your 2nd; avoid purchases. Wednesday is the turning point: Saturn enters your 10th and sextiles Uranus in your 1st, locking a career shift into place. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon moves through your 3rd, 4th, and 5th Houses, so paperwork, texts, logistics, and flirting improve with receipts. Wednesday is your power day because the Moon joins Jupiter in your 2nd while Saturn claims your 10th. Thursday is your worst day because the Moon conjuncts Mercury retrograde and South Node in your 3rd House. As Mercury's Air sign, write before speaking. Follow for daily updates, Gemini.
